fields.Name: Sonar — Recompute Member Engagement Score (nightly)
fields.Description: Recomputes the MoreCheese Sonar model "Member Engagement Score" so its scores exist on a fresh install and stay current. Sonar has no scheduler of its own — a published model holds no scores until something recomputes it — so this job drives the "Sonar: Recompute Model" action through the generic ActionScheduledJobDriver. RunImmediatelyIfNeverRun=true makes the first run happen on the scheduler's first poll after install instead of waiting for the nightly tick.
